title: Testing TP1-14482 Visual Workflow Diff for Revisions
description:
Purpose: validate TP1-14482 "Visual Workflow Diff for Revisions".

Implementation: backend repository testproject1, MR !4214 — TP1-14482: Add POST /v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/validate dry-run endpoint; frontend repository testproject1-ui, MR !1881 — TP1-14482: Add visual workflow diff view to version history.
acceptance_criteria: Visual revision diff opens from workflow version history.
A single graph represents the target revision.
Added nodes are highlighted in green.
Removed nodes are displayed at their former position with red styling, REMOVED badge and strikethrough label.
Modified nodes are highlighted distinctly/amber without exposing exact changed values in the visual view.
YAML/text diff remains available as the detailed alternative view.
Zoom, fit-view and drag-to-pan work correctly.
Restoring a revision triggers workflow validation automatically.
Validation errors are displayed inline after restore.
Restore validation does not persist workflow changes to the backend.
POST /v1/workflows/{workflow_id}/validate executes the same required pre-persist validation pipeline as workflow update.
Validation endpoint performs no database write.
Existing workflow versioning/text diff behavior is not regressed.
